The Chinese characters for Iris

As a transliteration, Iris is usually written 艾里斯 (Ài lǐ sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

艾
Ài
mugwort, artemisia
里
lǐ
inside, a mile
斯
sī
this (transliteration)

Origin and meaning

The name Iris has Greek roots and means “rainbow”.

About the name Iris

The Greek goddess of the rainbow and a messenger of the gods.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Iris carries the meaning “rainbow” and looks striking in brush strokes.
